build.description: Build the Rust workspace via cargo (debug profile).

lint.description: Lint the Rust workspace via clippy (deny warnings).

test.description: Run the Rust test suite via cargo test.

deps-install.description: Fetch the Rust crate dependencies into the local cargo cache (offline-capable afterwards). Runs in the workspace root. riskClass workspace_write (subject to policies.approvals — default: allowed for unattended operation), exposure-filtered output (specs/015 FR-1211).

deps-reinstall.description: Reset the Rust build state: cargo clean removes target/ (the next build re-fetches and recompiles from scratch — use for corrupted incremental state or toolchain/ABI mismatches). Platform note: spawns cargo directly (no shell). riskClass workspace_write (subject to policies.approvals — default: allowed for unattended operation), exposure-filtered output (specs/015 FR-1212).

capture-session-lessons.description: Seed validated session lessons. The agent writes .guidance/state/session-lessons.json BEFORE calling complete_workflow ([{slug, observation, cause, fix}]; empty array = explicit no-op success; a MISSING file FAILS the gate — the lessons review step must not be skipped; redact secrets — the script bypasses Guidance pattern redaction). Idempotent per slug. Note: runs node directly (no shell indirection); node is resolved via PATH first, then the workspace venv (.venv/bin, .venv/Scripts). Deployment values live in the env map (127.0.0.1 for containerized EMMS deployments).
